# Graziano Law Group, PLLC

> Florida law firm of attorney Philip W. Graziano in Pembroke Pines, serving clients in person in Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach Counties and by video anywhere in Florida. Practice areas: estate planning, family law, real estate, and traffic tickets. Flat-fee pricing is available for estate planning and most other matters. Spanish-language pages are available.

- Address: 15800 Pines Blvd., Suite 3081, Pembroke Pines, FL 33027
- Phone: (954) 440-6608
- Email: pwg@grazianolawgroup.com
- Website: https://grazianolawgroup.com/

## Practice areas
- [Estate Planning](https://grazianolawgroup.com/estate-planning.html): wills, trusts, powers of attorney, health care surrogate designations
- [Family Law](https://grazianolawgroup.com/family-law.html): divorce, parenting plans and time-sharing, child support, modifications
- [Real Estate](https://grazianolawgroup.com/real-estate.html): closings, deeds, title and transaction matters
- [Traffic Tickets](https://grazianolawgroup.com/traffic-tickets.html): Florida traffic citations, including CDL and out-of-state drivers
